notes:
Account overview: Mid-market B2B SaaS (outbound sales enablement). Product: AI-powered SDR chat agents that can call tools (CRM updates, send emails, schedule meetings) directly from chat UI. Current infra: mix of managed API + homegrown rules. Priority: improve reply latency and enable reliable two-way actions (e.g., create SFDC contact, send follow-up email, book meeting).

POC details: running 2-week Hosted API POC. Technical owners: CTO (Marta Gomez), Lead Backend Eng (Eli Turner), Head of Product (Samir Khan). SE assigned (Priya) joined calls. POC goals: validate low-latency streaming for agent UX (target p50 <150ms), test tool-calling reliability and idempotency, evaluate cost tradeoffs vs current provider, validate SSO and audit logging.

Performance notes: During demo they emphasized streaming + function/tool calling (calendar, gmail send, Salesforce API write). Report: p50 spikes up to ~300ms under small load, p90 up to 700ms in one test. Prospect says: "Feel must be instantaneous for SDRs — delays kill conversion". Eng asked about batching/kv-cache behaviors and autoscaling for bursts (end-of-day outbound blasts). Interested in Dedicated to guarantee throughput and lower tail latency.

Security/compliance: need SOC2, SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retention 90 days, and ability to restrict EU customer data to EU region (data residency question for a subset of customers). Legal wants a draft DPA before procurement.

Integration & implementation: primary integrations: Salesforce (REST API), Gmail API (send), Calendar (Google Calendar / Outlook), internal CRM webhooks. They require example webhooks and call flow from Redwood, sample rollback/fallback behavior for failed tool-calls. Ask: can Redwood expose a tool-calling sandbox for POC?

Business case & economics: estimated ARR if successful: $75k-$200k/year. They expect to start Hosted and move to Dedicated within 3-6 months if latency and cost targets are met. Interested in committed reserved capacity pricing for Dedicated.

Quotes / verbatims: "If we can get stable sub-200ms streaming and 99% tool-call success, this replaces a lot of our homegrown scaffolding" — Marta (CTO).

Next steps: finish POC telemetry (endpoints: p50/p90 streaming latency, tool-call success rates), share Dedicated sizing & pricing mid-March, legal to review DPA, schedule follow-up with Eng (wk of 2026-03-15).

Open blockers: latency under realistic concurrency, pricing fit vs. current provider, legal/data residency + DPA.
